name: kaijan-qa
description: Understand your application, plan tests and review results with Kaijan.

defaultPrompt: Use Kaijan to explore an existing app map.
Use Kaijan to assess the risk of a change.
Use Kaijan to plan and run a test scenario on my app, assess its evidence and show the report.
interface.longDescription:
Use Kaijan in chat to understand an application, assess changes and run test scenarios.

Start with a message:

• Use Kaijan to explore an existing app map.

• Use Kaijan to assess the risk of a change.

• Use Kaijan to plan and run a test scenario on my app, assess its evidence and show the report.

Select Try now to start a chat, then send one of these messages or describe your own goal. Kaijan will ask for the missing repository, change or test details.

Some actions need a connection or configured AI provider. Setup can collect your goal while these execution prerequisites are pending.
